_about: Public-domain John Mason Neale (1818-1866, Anglican priest, hymn translator and historian of the Eastern Church) for the Word Hoard: 12 volumes from Internet Archive scans: the History of the Holy Eastern Church (Alexandria, 2 vols, 1847, and the General Introduction, vol. I, 1850), Mediaeval Hymns and Sequences (1851) and Hymns of the Eastern Church (1862) in his own translations, the Commentary on the Psalms (4 vols, 1868-1874, vols II-IV with R. F. Littledale), the Essays on Liturgiology (1863) and Sermons Preached in a Religious House (2 vols). Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 28 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
